comment: One written-tag-name fixture, evaluated by both ends: the frontend's offline lookup lib/data/tagPaths.ts findTagIdByPath (src/test/writtenTagNameParity.test.ts) and the backend's tagHierarchy.tagIdForWrittenName (packages/backend/src/test/writtenTagNameParity.integration.test.ts), which quick capture, frontmatter/import tags and block-node {tags} all resolve through (D63). A path is walked from the root, so a bare name is a ROOT tag; under each parent the tag titled exactly so wins, else the ONE whose title matches case-insensitively, else nothing (null: with create, a new tag). Each case is its own workspace; `resolve` maps a written name to the tag key it names, or null.

cases.title: a bare name is the root tag, never a nested one
one case-insensitive match is that tag
the exact title wins over another case
path segments fold case one level at a time
segments are trimmed and empty ones dropped
a name matches in either Unicode form (NFC, D58)
